implementation_summary: Added copy(**kwargs) method to Todo class that creates an independent copy with optional field overrides. The method leverages existing to_dict() and from_dict() methods. Updated_at is automatically refreshed unless explicitly provided.
acceptance_criteria_met: todo.copy() returns new Todo with identical field values
todo.copy(text='new') returns Todo with updated text but same id
Original todo is unchanged after copy operation
Copied todo has new updated_at timestamp
